build.interpretation: Reporter receives command/redirection/setup shell status; the step retains the original effective0/1 xcodebuild-status test. A nonzero value does not independently establish that xcodebuild launched.

ui.interpretation: Reporter receives command/redirection/setup shell status; exact saved UI status determines step exit. A nonzero value does not independently establish that Node launched.

contract.setup: Only mkdir -p of the fixed sibling folder; no runtime-ui-ios creation. Failed setup prints a fixed marker, preserves its failure status and does not run the native command. No fallback or retry.
contract.reporting: Reporter is called once after the attempted command/setup settles and shell redirections close; || : makes a reporter failure secondary. Fixed capture files may be absent or partial. Existing files/status alone do not establish execution or complete/fresh command output.
contract.upload: One new sibling directory in the existing always() iOS evidence upload; existing /tmp/xcodebuild.log and runtime-ui-ios paths remain.

unchangedRunUi.inspection: Source uses exclusive mkdirSync(runtime-ui-ios), internal UTF-8-decoded stdout+stderr concatenation for subprocess logs, original first-error throw and cleanup; none modified. Raw top-level captured streams must be distinguished from these existing decoded nested logs.
